First-Uppers — Be Careful

Most horses resuming from a spell — say 60 days or more — will lose at their first run back. That's an iron-clad fact.

Studying The Form

When you study the form, ask what the horse's claims to the race are, whether its recent form lays a viable claim, and whether there is an earlier race you can relate to this one.

The Price

The winner was more or less neglected in the pre-race summaries and in the betting. He was sent out at 12/1, and any punter who took the time would have been forewarned that he was a better chance than his odds indicated.
